items.title: Stefon Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2020
items.q: I remember playing with Joe Henderson and a couple of us in the band

ctx.x: I have the improviser’s mindset so that I’ve shown up and there were cracked notes, but in the concert I’ll use those notes. A note is just another sound that I can use in the process of improvisation. So — I remember playing with Joe Henderson and a couple of us in the band, Joe was going through a period where he was trying out a bunch of drummers. And on occasion he’d try someone who really didn’t work out. So some of us were young, we were in the back and we were talking like, “Oh man, this guy messed up my…
